description:
Simmer Wallet Setup v0.4.0

Self-custody wallet setup for Simmer agents. Bring your own key, import a funded Polymarket wallet, or connect an existing dashboard-registered agent to your local runtime. Skip this skill if you use a managed wallet — managed setup is a one-time dashboard flow, not an agent task.

Runs in dry-run paper mode by default (dry_run=true). Set trading_venue to 'sim', 'polymarket', or 'kalshi'.

dry_run.description: If false, may place real orders (requires SIMMER_MCP_ALLOW_LIVE=true env). Default: paper mode.

extra_args.description: Pass-through CLI flags. Live-trading flags (--live, --no-dry-run, --mode=live, etc.) are filtered.

name: simmer_simmer_wallet_setup
